prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Meet Your Desktop Companion", "Choose the pet personality and appearance that will keep you company on your screen."]
1: ["Save Your Custom Pet", "Sign in now to lock in your pet choice and sync across your devices."]
2: ["Choose Pet Behavior Style", "Pick how your pet acts on your desktop: energetic explorer, calm desk companion, or playful buddy.", "Select behavior trait", "Confirm Traits"]
3: ["Your Pet is Live on Your Desktop!", "Right-click your pet anytime to hide, chat, or access quick controls. Drag your pet anywhere on screen.", "Start Exploring"]
4: ["Sign In & Restore Your Pets", "Log into your account to automatically sync and restore all your saved desktop pets and preferences."]
5: ["Special Offer: Completing setup today unlocks bonus desktop accessories for your new companion!", "Includes Starter Accessory Bundle"]
6: ["Rendering Desktop Overlay", "Configuring display drivers and desktop screen bounds for seamless pet movement..."]
7: ["How Would You Like to Adopt?", "Pick a ready-made companion from our collection or create a custom pet from your photos."]
8: ["Quick Tip: Press Alt+P anytime to hide or bring your pet back to the front of your desktop."]
9: ["Use clear, well-lit photos. If processing takes long, standard companion features will auto-apply so you won't get stuck."]

verdicts.problem: Creates urgency and mentions bonus/free extras for completing setup today.
Requests personal photos from the user.
